subject: Draftsperson (Land Surveying) application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Steve Cooper and Associates team,

I'm applying for the Draftsperson (Land Surveying) role advertised on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your advert asks how existing skills transfer: my earthworks and road geometry coursework was drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and I designed around existing services and site constraints. My drafting so far is from study, not a paid drafting role, and I am open to discussing relocation to Brisbane.

Would you be open to a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Draftsperson (Land Surveying)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Draftsperson (Land Surveying) role at Steve Cooper and Associates advertised on SEEK. Drafting contour and detail survey plans for the housing industry, with in house training, is a good next step for me after my civil design studies.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. My course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against the work, carried out site inspections and quality checks, and prepared site reports and progress records.

I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton and am open to discussing relocation to Brisbane. My drafting and software experience is from study rather than a paid drafting role, and I am keen to keep learning from your team.
Thank you for considering my application. Some of my course drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
